decisions.reason: The firm has invested in staff and reimbursement arrangements for outpatient sociotherapy and promoted it to the home page in 2024, so it is now a visible part of its announced direction and dropping it would expose the earlier decision as a mistake.

The senior living counseling service has been featured on the home page in both years, so the firm's public commitment is strong and the service sits at the core of its eldercare offer, which makes withdrawal unlikely.

The retail shop was moved up to the home page in 2024 and draws on the sheltered workshop's production investment, so any weak sales would likely be put down to a start-up phase rather than prompt closure.

The meal delivery service is new, has had little investment and is only mentioned on the website, so it could be dropped more easily, but it is too early to rule out temporary causes for any weak results, and it fits the firm's eldercare offer.
